acceptance_rule: Official vendor/company source + explicit date in research window + specialized AI-assisted legal writing/drafting/work-product capability.

records.specialization: Legal AI agents with matter/project context and memory designed to carry professional work context into drafting and other legal tasks.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: Shows that elite drafting quality increasingly depends on persistent matter context and user/firm working patterns rather than one-shot prompting.

records.specialization: Agentic legal workflow spanning research, analysis, drafting and review-ready legal work product, with authoritative Lexis sources and verification tooling.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: Supports a source-first drafting architecture in which research authority, organization documents, draft generation and review stay connected.

records.specialization: Purpose-built legal work-product system using Westlaw, Practical Law and firm knowledge for research, analysis and drafting from plain-language instructions.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: Reinforces that high-end output should be grounded in trusted authority and institutional knowledge, not generic stylistic imitation.

records.specialization: Purpose-built legal agents and skills for contract review/drafting and other legal workflows, designed to work with firm playbooks, citation rules, internal knowledge and house style.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: Direct evidence that house style should be encoded as explicit standards/playbooks with governance rather than vague prompts to sound like a lawyer.

records.specialization: Reusable legal AI Skills let firms encode task-specific research approaches, contract drafting standards and document-review conventions in plain language and apply them consistently.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: Strongly validates a portable skill model: turn firm judgment and drafting conventions into explicit reusable instructions rather than session-by-session prompt tricks.

records.specialization: AI company focused on legal workflows and improving legal writing at every stage, especially low-risk, high-volume drafting work.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: A writing-specific launch that separates legal drafting quality and workflow needs from general-purpose copywriting.

records.specialization: Legal AI workflow connects firm-approved precedent, first-draft creation, deterministic comparison, risk understanding and proposed response language inside the negotiation workflow.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: Shows the value of connecting precedent selection, drafting, redline analysis, risk interpretation and response language rather than treating writing as a standalone text-generation step.

records.specialization: Legal intake can automatically start AI-agent work; Wordsmith's legal agents can chain drafting into end-to-end workflows from request through draft, approval and delivery.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: Adds the operating-model insight that excellent correspondence starts with structured intake and context capture before a drafting agent is invoked.

records.specialization: AI-native contract lifecycle automation built around intake, first-pass review/redlining and ongoing contract work; Spellbook's associated June product suite also combines browser drafting/editing with tracked AI changes.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: Demonstrates continuous contract context plus drafting/review loops, useful for correspondence that must stay aligned with the latest negotiated paper and obligations.

records.specialization: More than 100 attorney-built legal workflows including indemnity redlines, termination-clause structuring, negotiation-ready counterproposals and contract summaries.
records.why_it_matters_for_this_skill: Validates a task-specific workflow catalog where each drafting objective has its own legal structure and quality standard instead of one universal style prompt.
